title: deposit-check: checking the DOI metadata of a researcher's deposits against their ORCID record
description: deposit-check reads the DOI metadata of a researcher's works, from DataCite, Crossref and JaLC, and says what is missing or inconsistent against the researcher's ORCID record: abstracts, licences, ORCID iDs on the author's name, the links between versions, and works missing from the ORCID record. It writes nothing anywhere and needs no key or account; it sends only the ORCID iD and the DOIs.
